killedBy: vendored third-party source (issue #771) declares every file carrying a third-party provenance marker, as vendored or as first-party with a reason
why: Replaces the marker list with one pattern that matches no source file, so the scan passes over every file and reports nothing undeclared. A guard whose scan is blind looks exactly like a clean tree; only the in-test control, which expects hypot.ts to be named when it is left off the list, can tell them apart.
